_comment: Figures and rules transcribed from the documents in sources/ for data/able-parameters.json. The contribution limit through 2025 is the IRC 2503(b) gift exclusion, read from each year's inflation-adjustment Revenue Procedure; 2026 is read from Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.34, which states the ABLE amount separately.

2015.ableToWork_source: IRC 529A(b)(2)(B)(ii) was added by Pub. L. 115-97 section 11024(a), applicable to taxable years beginning after December 22, 2017 (usc-26-529A effective-date note)
